title: TenK10K Phase 1 effector genes: analysis pipelines and figure code
description: Code accompanying Single-cell genetics identifies cell type-specific causal mechanisms in complex traits and diseases (medRxiv doi:10.1101/2025.08.28.25334614): Snakemake pipelines that produce the Mendelian randomisation, colocalisation, MAGMA, scDRS, enrichment and Open Targets results from GWAS and single-cell eQTL summary statistics, and the scripts that rebuild every figure and supplementary table from the companion data record (make data, then make all).
